_doc: Scene prompts for product-concept-photo. The product is NEVER generated: scripts/render_concepts.py places the real cut-out, the engine fills only the scene, and the original product pixels are pasted back. {product}, {light}, {palette}, {props} are filled from concept_spec.json. Write prompts positively; unwanted things go in negative_base / negative_extra.
negative_base: text, letters, words, typography, caption, watermark, logo, brand name, label, signage, sticker, badge, seal, certificate, stamp, extra product, duplicate product, second package, person, face, head, body, skin close-up, nudity, anatomy, pills, tablets, capsules, syringe, medical equipment, milky liquid, cartoon, illustration, painting, cgi, 3d render, plastic look, distorted, deformed, warped, blurry, lowres, oversaturated
negative_hands: text, letters, words, typography, caption, watermark, logo, brand name, label, signage, sticker, badge, seal, certificate, stamp, extra product, duplicate product, second package, face, head, torso, extra fingers, deformed hands, nudity, anatomy, pills, tablets, capsules, syringe, medical equipment, milky liquid, cartoon, illustration, painting, cgi, 3d render, distorted, deformed, warped, blurry, lowres, oversaturated

brand_negative.rejal: green, leaves, moss, grass, foliage, plants, organic label
brand_negative.ssclinic: doctor, nurse, patient, hospital bed, clinic interior

prompts.title: Gray studio gradient
prompts.scene: high-end product photograph of {product} on a smooth seamless gray gradient studio backdrop, softboxes on both sides, subtle floor reflection, luxury commercial studio setup

prompts.title: Floating product shot
prompts.scene: product photograph of {product} hovering in mid-air above a clean studio floor, a soft round shadow on the floor below it, crisp high-speed studio flash, modern commercial style

prompts.title: Flat lay e-commerce shot
prompts.scene: top-down flat lay photograph of {product} lying on a neutral matte paper surface, two or three small minimal props at the edges, balanced composition, soft natural window light

prompts.title: In-hand lifestyle shot
prompts.scene: lifestyle photograph of {product} resting on the open flat palm of a man's hand, fingers relaxed and below the product, natural daylight, shallow depth of field, soft blurred home background, candid commercial feel
flags: Hands: fingers must stay under/behind the product; check grip looks physically real

Concept art: not a size claim

prompts.title: Before/after implication
prompts.scene: split composition photograph: left half a dim, cluttered, ordinary bathroom counter in flat grey light; right half the same counter clean and bright with {product} standing on it in fresh daylight; consistent camera across both halves
flags: Before/after: human check that no result or performance is implied (MENSS: no size/performance)
Problem side shows objects only, never people

prompts.title: Proof stack visual
prompts.scene: product photograph of {product} with {props} arranged neatly around it on a clean light surface, organized composition, credibility-forward DTC sales page
flags: Props only from brand.json product_facts; certification marks are never generated (composite real files later)
